description: Attach a GDScript or C# script to a node in a scene, replacing any script it had. Check the script with the validate tool first. C# needs the Godot .NET build with the class compiled into the project assembly. Saves automatically. Returns: nodePath and scriptPath. Errors if the script cannot be instantiated (parse errors, @abstract, or an unbuilt C# class), or if scriptPath or nodePath does not exist. Errors while a runtime session is live on this project.

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

scenePath.description: Scene file path relative to the project

scriptPath.description: Path to the script file relative to the project (e.g. "scripts/player.gd" or "scripts/Player.cs"). A .cs file needs the Godot .NET build and its class compiled into the project assembly (dotnet build).

name: attach_script

nodePath.description: Path from the scene root in "root/..." form, read from the node.

scriptPath.description: Project-relative path of the script that was attached.
